title: Raid on the Medway
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Raid on the Medway", at revision 1382431665, opens: "The Raid on the Medway, during the Second Anglo-Dutch War between June 12 to 14 June 1667, was a successful attack conducted by the Dutch navy on English warships laid up in the fleet anchorages off Chatham Dockyard and Gillingham in the county of Kent. At the time, the fortress of Upnor Castle and a barrier chain called the "Gillingham Line" were supposed to protect the English ships." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q331740, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Dutch naval attack (1667) during the Second Anglo-Dutch War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
